{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "threshold": 100.0,
            "threshold_operator": "=",
            "penalty_amount": 1000,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 10,
            "description": "10% penalty if availability impact is 100%",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 5,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if initial response time is more than 5 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "RTOSLAMinutes",
            "threshold": 60,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 800,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 8,
            "description": "8% penalty if recovery time objective (RTO) exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_004",
            "metric": "RPOSLAMinutes",
            "threshold": 60,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 600,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 6,
            "description": "6% penalty if recovery point objective (RPO) exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "condition": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage = 100",
            "penalty_rule": "10% penalty if availability impact is 100%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty if initial response time is more than 5 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "RTOSLAMinutes",
            "condition": "RTOSLAMinutes > 60",
            "penalty_rule": "8% penalty if recovery time objective (RTO) exceeds 60 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "RPOSLAMinutes",
            "condition": "RPOSLAMinutes > 60",
            "penalty_rule": "6% penalty if recovery point objective (RPO) exceeds 60 minutes"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, DetectedAt, AvailabilityImpactPercentage, InitialResponseTimeMinutes, RTOSLAMinutes, RPOSLAMinutes, CASE WHEN AvailabilityImpactPercentage = 100 THEN 1000 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5 THEN 500 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN RTOSLAMinutes > 60 THEN 800 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN RPOSLAMinutes > 60 THEN 600 ELSE 0 END AS TotalPenalty FROM incidents_database_service WHERE SLABreached = TRUE ORDER BY DetectedAt",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DetectedAt", "AvailabilityImpactPercentage", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes", "RTOSLAMinutes", "RPOSLAMinutes", "SLABreached"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 20000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 20
}
